instructions: Final scientific and component claim mapping. Independent numerical audit, canonical PDF, packaged-paper rebuild, all-page review, raw archive and extractor checks are complete. Source preparation is additive; owner review, merge, public release and new served-file status are not claimed. The complete outer archive has a detached final identity to avoid self-hashing.

claims.claim_or_question: Previous evidence remains immutable; acquisition failure was reconciled
claims.scope_limit: Historical frozen evidence is not a new development or confirmation sample.

observed_outcome.proximate_failure: Fixed acquisition allocation plus conservative complete-pipeline preflight exhausted exploration before one candidate completed six training cases; the economic admission gate was never reached.

claims.claim_or_question: Domain choice and development search were prospectively bounded
claims.scope_limit: Selection rationale and all bounded variants must remain visible; no held-out selection claim.

observed_outcome.selection_scope: Development only; not selection on fresh confirmation outcomes

claims.claim_or_question: An initial qualified computation supplied the executable parent used by the next fresh mission
claims.scope_limit: Numerical qualification on synthetic modeled inputs; no physical-world validation or customer acceptance is implied.

claims.claim_or_question: The flywheel qualified 156 fresh successor outputs that actually invoked the parent
claims.scope_limit: Fresh parent-call total is over qualified D results, not an independent sample count. Stream-level uncertainty is required.

claims.claim_or_question: Eighteen scoped changed-operator successor instances were constructed from actual accepted predecessors
claims.scope_limit: Construction and qualified fresh use establish the executed narrower mechanism, not product benefit or discovery acceleration. These are instances of the fixed Woodbury construction vocabulary, not eighteen discovered algorithm families.

requirement.selection_rule: largest absolute edge flow in actual accepted B08; stable index tie break

claims.claim_or_question: Meaningful whole-workflow product benefit was not established against the strong native comparator
claims.scope_limit: Primary benefit requires upper 95% CPU-ratio bound below 0.95. Noninferiority is a separate guard and does not establish superiority.

primary_comparison.interpretation: descriptive except native_refactor primary and conventional guard

conventional_comparison.interpretation: descriptive except native_refactor primary and conventional guard

independent_primary.sampling: Paired stream bootstrap within each workload regime; retain each stratum size, then ratio of pooled means. No task-level independence.

independent_conventional_guard.sampling: Paired stream bootstrap within each workload regime; retain each stratum size, then ratio of pooled means. No task-level independence.

observed_outcome.interval_relation: Independent RNG sampling layout gives a small Monte Carlo interval difference. Point estimate and gate decision agree; neither interval replaces the other.

claims.claim_or_question: Service and improvement allocations are separate and source-bound
claims.scope_limit: Observed-cost enforcement is not OS preemption; overrun blocks acceptance.

observed_outcome.control_scope: Reservations and observed native costs, not OS preemption

claims.claim_or_question: 9,600 ms of externally supplied service quota was released; 1,034.057 ms was debited for construction
claims.scope_limit: Quota conservation and actual debit are demonstrated. Capability-caused savings, cash earned and recovery of the full research investment are not established.

observed_outcome.account_rounding: Each action debit rounded upward to whole microseconds; unrounded CPU remains separate

claims.claim_or_question: Restart, lost acknowledgement and duplicate recovery preserve accepted work
claims.scope_limit: Two distinct operational records: the earlier unfrozen development probe and the later exact-source probe on the same declared development network. Neither is an additional efficacy confirmation. Both differ from the confirmation's matched memory eviction.

frozen_source_operational_probe.scope: operational development probe, not confirmatory efficacy

claims.claim_or_question: The browser executes a fresh four-mission causal demonstration
claims.scope_limit: Separate64-node JavaScript mode; no native confirmation, earned-credit transfer, production authority or external proof.

observed_recorded_panel.headline: Successor works. Product benefit not established.

claims.claim_or_question: The requested foundation editions and mechanism roles are exact
claims.scope_limit: Exact neuralv0 URL bytes, no silent priorv1 substitution. Source ambitions are not this study’s results.

observed_outcome.edition_inspected: Requested URL edition with filename v0; document identifies itself as Definitive Corporate White Paper, 25 August 2026. No semantic version inferred from filename.

claims.claim_or_question: Actual Alpha interfaces and contract utility retain their boundaries
claims.scope_limit: Do not promote source inspection or unsigned draft compilation to live contract execution or settlement.

claims.claim_or_question: Measured native costs and zero intermediate campaign triggers are recorded; full investment recovery remains unresolved
claims.scope_limit: No intermediate campaign triggers excludes development/setup, which remain externally supplied and separately logged. Unknown human/model monetary costs are not zero.

observed_outcome.cost_boundary: Audit compute is additional research cost, not part of already measured service trials. Raw claimed totalCPU is reconciled to charged actions but cannot be independently reconstructed from CPU hardware after the fact.

claims.claim_or_question: Canonical paper rebuilt byte-identically from packaged LaTeX; all 23 final pages were visually reviewed
claims.scope_limit: Bind canonical author PDF and clean rebuild/render records after completion; no preassigned PASS.

claims.claim_or_question: Source preparation is additive; outer archive and future publication states use separate detached receipts
claims.scope_limit: Preserve historical URLs. Do not assign reviewed/merged/released/live status without exact owner and served-file evidence.

observed_outcome.outer_archive_identity: Detached; a ZIP cannot include its own final hash. Consult the delivered archive identities and payload manifest.

claims.claim_or_question: Exact frozen independent numerical and artifact audit completed with no detected issues
claims.scope_limit: Separate checker and aggregation; same commission and host. Reviewer also repaired executor validation before freeze. Producer totals were received before executing the frozen audit, so review was not blinded. Stored CPU telemetry and parent counters are not independently traced hardware evidence.

claims.claim_or_question: Retained parent reduces matched successor-construction work; conventional reuse obtains the same mechanism
claims.scope_limit: C algorithm CPU includes construction, one solve and NPZ persistence. Native C includes generic full-input inspection absent from the low-rank path; both receive final independent checking. Exact-reconstruction contrast is the cleaner inheritance comparison. Posthoc descriptive intervals do not replace the registered whole-system gate.

claims.claim_or_question: Retained storage counts unique physical asset paths rather than duplicated logical aliases

observed_outcome.counting_rule: Deduplicate identical paths within a trial; do not deduplicate independent trial copies. Whole evidence storage remains separate.

claims.scope_limit: Asset count is not capability growth. Direct specialist has no NPZ factors but still has raw evidence storage. Lifelong retention costs and indefinite growth were not measured.

claims.claim_or_question: Rare and maintenance workload means preserve cases favoring simpler conventional alternatives
claims.scope_limit: Six streams per regime; no additional confirmatory subgroup superiority claim. Wide-change flywheel does not construct a low-rank successor, so differences there cannot be attributed to that construction.

claims.claim_or_question: Recovered Strategy Laboratory v0.1.0 was verified and replayed in the prior edition; its status is preserved separately

prior_independent_artifact_audit.method: Separately written artifact and statistical checks; original generator inputs matched by hash

prior_exact_frozen_policy_replay.scope: Frozen policies and non-timing confirmation outputs/judgments; acquisition/development search not rerun

observed_outcome.prior_pilot_policy_replay: Preserved original log only; not freshly reexecuted

original.distribution: Original historical content retained in prior study and local custody; not required by this public companion.

public_projection.removed_fields: Exactly two provider-specific source-recovery record identifiers; no scientific result, source hash or limitation removed.

observed_outcome.full_original_payload_location: Prior Strategy Succession package; not duplicated or recreated by the new confirmation

claims.scope_limit: Original non-timing policies and judgments were replayed under CPython 3.13.5. Acquisition/development search was not freshly rerun. Equal exploration counts do not establish equal total computation, full-cost adoption or integrated production operation. The narrative is an explicitly named public projection; original content remains in prior-study custody. These historical records are not new Earned Turn observations.

claims.claim_or_question: Pinned raw evidence is lossless and the extractor restores exact bytes without clobbering existing evidence
claims.scope_limit: Per-file atomic no-replace installation, not one transaction over the entire archive. Verified prefixes may remain after interruption; an idempotent rerun preserves exact files. Symlink destinations/parents are refused. Byte verification does not rerun numerical experiments. Same-host integrity does not defeat a hostile administrator.

accounting_limits: Transferred quota originated from external endowment; it is not cash or independently established incremental savings.
Correctness qualification, whole-system product admission and full-investment recovery are separate decisions.
Full-cost participant CPU includes dispatch/checking/persistence/maintenance/control; independent audit and development remain additional research investment.
Unknown human/model/monetary costs are not zero; CPU, elapsed time and abstract work are distinct measures.
Construction phase includes one solve and persistence, and native/low-rank validation paths differ.
Storage deduplicates logical aliases to the same file and keeps executable asset bytes separate from full evidence bytes.
A fixed algorithm vocabulary and one successor depth do not establish discovery improvement or acceleration.
independence: Separate raw-data aggregation without producer analysis imports; checker separately sums node balances. Same commission and host; reviewer previously corrected executor validation and integer-ground assembly. Parent counters are producer instrumentation, independently attributed rather than CPU-traced.
path_resolution: Paths are relative to the research companion root. Restore losslessly compressed raw records with unpack_evidence.py before resolving their paths. The raw archive and packaged-LaTeX rebuild have completed verification records. The complete outer archive's final identity is detached from its payload; future publication observations do not retroactively grant authority.
